lede: The biggest thing to watch this week is the Telluride Medical Center's special meeting on a potential due-diligence engagement with CommonSpirit Health — one of the largest nonprofit hospital systems in the country — which could signal a major partnership or affiliation on the horizon. The Telluride Ecology Commission is also taking up a draft ordinance that would ban gas-powered lawn and garden equipment in town limits by 2028–2030, and Ouray City Council holds a public hearing on its 2027 budget with utility rate ordinances up for a second-reading vote. Closer to home, Mountainfilm for Locals runs Monday and Tuesday, and Halloween weekend wraps up with the Young Frankenstein musical co-production from TMHS and Telluride Theatre.

notable.stake: Board votes on due-diligence proposal that could reshape local hospital's future.
